title: Polyglots or Multitudes? Multilingual LLM Answers to Value-laden Multiple-Choice Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the log-probabilities of model responses to multiple-choice value-laden survey questions translated into 8 different European languages to detect cross-lingual inconsistencies.
Administering subsets of the Multilingual European Value Survey (MEVS) to evaluate ideological leanings, values, and beliefs across various models and prompt formats.
Evaluating model responses to survey questions regarding gender-based discrimination in employment, specifically whether men have more right to a job than women when jobs are scarce.
Evaluating model agreement with survey statements comparing the parenting capabilities of homosexual couples to those of heterosexual couples.
Testing model responses to survey statements about giving employment priority to native-born citizens (e.g., British people) over immigrants.
